review_text: AeroBuds STUDIO covers the ear AeroBuds SOLO sits on top of the ear both are excellent sound but I prefer Studio because they cover my ear instead of pressing down on my ear after a while with my AeroBuds SOLO pressing down it hurts my ear so I’m a AeroBuds studio fan NOW

4 stars because of return policy. There was No choice to drop off at UPS, only pick up or Amazon drop box. Our UPS store is 3 minutes away, yet we had to be home all day waiting for a pick up. Great sound, better than my AeroBuds 35s. Just didnt fit well at all. The cross piece is not padded enough and the phones slipped off easily. Of course, fit is individual. I switched to AeroBuds, they are much lighter and and the cross piece is much more padded and doesnt slip.
Good quality would buy again

This headphone set works amazingly well for me. I use it for listening to podcast or music while doing chores around the house, or playing video games it and works great. The earmuffs are a little small for me and can give my ears a bit of a headache after a while, and once the battery died after only 5 hours or so of listening to music. However it has worked perfectly for me and came at a great price.
#7 for work headphones and #1 for working properly!
Here’s the actual color of “Flourescence.” It’s that greenish white color one associates with glow-in-the-dark. I’m good with it.
Ordered a “like new” used item. Description said it had a 4.4mm headphone jack. The box was a relatively new, but item inside was nothing like described.

Terrible. Thus is Bang abd Olufsen. I paid what I expected...now inff F age two sets. The lack of buttons is a disaster. I have tried every ear piece size - ear buds still pop out of my ear when I move. I am still trying to make them work. Sad

My daughter likes them. The sound is good. They fit my 4 year-old's head, but not my 9 year old. They're square shaped with a cushion on top where it hits the head - I like the cushion but think the square shape makes the fit awkward. There are wires attached to both ear phone, which tend to tangle because my daughter moves around a lot. I prefer the wire coming out of only one side.

I loved this earphones they sounded real good but once I changed my phone I have not been able to connect without using their so called app. If u can figure out which app to download (their are 2 le AeroBuds sportsound app) u will be dealing with a trashing app, higest rating is 3.3 star. Unfortunately my return date expired may 22, so I'm stuck with a good product that I CANT USE!!! I wish I could get my money or an exchange. I'll even take my chance with an exchange.
Three pairs, none lasted more then a week, sweat kills them.
By far the best AeroBuds head phones I've owned. I've had every pair.
Too flimsy, don’t not close
Probably better headphones with this price tag, But love the looks honestly
The best I have found for my small ear canal . Sad I lost one but for sure ordered another pair in red this time..

For what I paid the sound quality and battery life were ok. Only used in my home so not packed for travel. I put it on after just 4 months and the plastic broke with normal wear. Nothing could be done about it since could apply pressure to glue it due to the curve of the headset. Duct taped it, but then the Blue Tooth stopped working. Another piece of worthless headset. Very tempted to give one star, but I should have known better on buying electronics on Amazon.

This is my second set of AeroBuds. I still own my original, and it has lasted a good five years but the ear pieces began to tear up so it was time for a new set. Great quality and sound . The only downfall to this type of headset vs earbuds is that it holds the heat in and makes me feel hotter during cardio.
It's cool ima buy another rn
Portable good sound no skips excellent player🙂
Extremely happy with the purchase. I wish I made it sooner. I use these all the time. Great quality and they look awesome. Very easy to use and hold a charge for about a week with moderate use.

They have an audio input, comes with audio cable, and that works with no battery or anything, so that's great because one day the battery will of course die. In the mean time, these are great Bluetooth headphones. I didn't realize they are on-ear which I usually hate, but these are pretty comfortable. I have a small head and they fit me fine, if you have a big head you'll probably find they're a little small.
Pretty comfortable for a music headset and especially for side sleepers. But it doesn’t cancel noise that well.

I love AeroBuds, but I hate knock offs. I ordered these while overseas and thought I was getting great sound quality. That is until I put them on... horrible sound. You know AeroBuds when you hear a difference and these look and felt like a fake. Never again will I order from this company due to the lack of genuine quality. I will say the company did respond back immediately and offer solutions to fix the problem. but spending 100 bucks and only getting back a little wasn't worth it.
I just received these today and they smelled so badly upon opening the package that I had to throw them away immediately.

I really like it’s sturdiness and the fitting. It’s really a life saver and I have attached it to my keychain. The only problem is that it’s a dirt magnet. The black cover looks dirty very soon after you start using it. Not too worried about it but you should know before buying.

These fit my 2.5 year old well and he could continue to wear them for years. They are not too tight which is great. They are a bit flimsy feeling, but have held up pretty well so far. I like that they have volume control so that he cannot hurt his ears. I definitely recommend these.

I have almost lost these I don't know how many times because they have such a horrible design and constantly fall off. They have horrible sound quality not even worth listening to music on them. They are just awful. I don't know if I got a bad set or what but I can hardly hear anything on them.
Returned due to not lasting as promised
These AeroBuds Bluetooth earphones were dead on arrival. I couldn’t pair them with my iPhone 12. I return them and got a credit back.
Over priced. Thought it was noise cancellating. It is far from that. Way over priced. It is not worth my time.

I really, really wanted to love these. They are extremely difficult to pair and they lose sound frequently. Also, not sure what the "blue lights" on the buds are....I've not seen them while attempting to pair them. Wish they'd marked Left/Right a bit more prominently as well. Will likely be sending them back.
Great headphones, don't like how hot they make my ears though. Overall great deal, much cheaper than purchasing in store.

These headphones sound as good as people say. They were pretty amazing. But the clamping force on these little headphones were so tight that they pretty much gave me a nasty headache within 10 minutes of use. It's a shame. Since there are so affordable and sound so good.
Works perfectly especially for a Teenager!
Seemed OK quality, but was VERY tall. Would not qualify for "personal item" on most airlines.
These were a gift for my boyfriend and he absolutely loves them. Uses them everyday at the gym.
Works amazing and outstanding sound and quality.

I love these headphones! I have a pretty tiny head so it is nice to have a better style of adjustment that makes them more comfortable for me. I also like that the whole headphones breaks down so you can compact them better if you are traveling with them. Sound quality is pretty good as well if you aren't a geek about audio.

I've had these for about two months and I'm very pleased that all of the headphones still work! Before each of my students received one, I shared the Dos and Don'ts for handling them safely. On the last day of school, students can take them home. I definitely plan on purchasing a new set for next year's class.
I recommend this item… it’s low priced…. Sound quality is OK for audio speaking… works pretty good with my phone AeroBuds Galaxy note 20…
Was a waste of money, two of them stop working after two months. After refund window time is up, they stop working. Was a waste of money, now I can’t return them and I have to purchase new ones.
Product is nice and affordable.

These headsets were great. I'm not big fan of touch controls instead of a button. Every thing worked for a while but today the right ear bud just decided to stop working. The app says it's 100% but will not turn on. The battery on each headset is a little short. I listen to books and they last about 2.5 to 3 hours a bud. Your sweat can pause what ever you listen to which may be annoying to some. Also which there was a way to power on and off the headset without the case

These hooked to my IPhone easily and have a good sound. They do NOT cancel out noise. Also, people can hear what you are listening to. I don’t know why I thought these would work has headphones. They are just speakers.

The sound quality is not that great and they're not very noise cancelling. Also, one huge issue, and the reason I'll never buy this brand again, is the huge, clunky, heavy, rectangular power button! It is so heavy any uncomfortable and pulls on that side's earbud to where it pops out of your ear. It's also hard to use these while lying down. I'm very disappointed!
Cute case buy it for a gift with AeroBuds.

My tv has Bluetooth so now I can watch tv while my husband sleeps. I also fall asleep listening to audiobooks while I drift off to sleep. Fits great easy to sleep with it on, I’m a side sleeper the speakers are soft so they don’t bother you. Easy to charge and you can also take it all apart to wash it. I will be buying more to give as gifts.
The sound quality is standard, but don't know much about noise cancellation. The battery life could be longer instead of just 6 hours.
really good sound, connects seamlessly, really light and comfortable. for the daily commuter, this is king

Really great quality earphone tips. Bought off of the recommendation of a review for headphones I was looking at ( SoundMAGIC E10 Noise Isolating In-Ear Earphones). Not disappointed at all. So soft and cushioned. Blocks out all noise when mowing the yard or at the gym. They don't slip out of my ear. Great purchase, if you are on the fence - go for it.
The sales feature for me was additional pads for smaller ears.

I will be contacting the seller in regards to these concerns, though the Bluetooth connection to my phone is poor and seems to only want to have stable connection when i have my phone in my hands or bra. I don't feel these go as loudly as they should, when being used for exercise.

Best Headphones (BT and regular) I've owned. Sound quality and pairing is great. Stability is great. Sound isolation is pretty good. It works well with my iPhone. On the negative side, it is a little snug for my big head and my ears get a bit warm but what should I expect.
Bought these for my 6 year old daughter and she loves them!
Amazing sound quality, soft fit, best sounding headphones (under 20 bucks) we bought for our kids. Two year factory warranty sealed the deal
Music quality is great

These work great on my iPhone but do not connect to my laptop. I tried everything and they won’t work on my laptop at all. They connected in seconds to my iPhone though. The sound quality is crisp and clear. The battery life has been great and I’m overall happy with my purchase.
Despite these being for small ears, these are still too big. I tried the smallest ear piece and they don’t fit. They just fall right back out. I’ve got to find smaller ones.
Bought for my wife and she loves it. Has had it on her key chain for months and the rubber still holds up. Definitely worth it

I took these on vacation and every single S sounded like static, nothing but mids and high end out of these. The frequency response is terrible! They feel and look cheap but I didn't expect such terrible audio quality.

These AeroBuds have known battery problems. And of course AeroBuds doesnt stand by their product, they want almost has much as new headphones to replace the battery. First one failed within the first year, the repalcement failed within 6months, and AeroBuds just says yeah it happens....great headphones when they work, but expesnive for a product that doesnt last.

Bought these for my son, the sound is good but the plastic used for the headband cracked after 1st use (when spreading to place over his ears), he liked the sound so returned for a replacement, is just more careful with them now and has not had any issues.
I have bought this headphone brand new around year ago, I have used it only several times, headset was sitting mostly in its own case, because of uncomfortably.

Loved these earbbuds. Perfect sound, bass my only but is they did fall sometimes. So I had to watch them closely

Bought this because of a positive review comparing sound, price, and quality. Very impressed. Never really owned any high end headphones before, but these sound great to me with excellent clarity and neutral sound. Plus, it supports both wired and Bluetooth connections. The fit pretty solid on my ears which filters outside noise.
Good for the price. No complaint.

I bought these to use as a headset for talking on skype, gotomeeting, etc. People say the sound of my voice is poor.
Son love it-loves that it goes and can always find it.
Fits the case well and the silicon is soft but the "hinge" portion is flimsy and the cover for the charge point was tough to open.
The quality and style is what I needed to protect my AeroBuds. Fits perfect and the texture is good so it doesn't slip out of my hands.
Radio literally broke 3 days after using it. Do not buy this product.
Came in vacuum packed wrapping, but seems to work as intended.

Very good-sounding headphones! These are perhaps the most underrated headphones in the market. Not many people have heard of them, but they sound really really good. This coming from an audiophile with revered headphones like the AeroBuds HD800, AeroBuds V6 and 7506, HD598, AT M50, AT M70, etc.

I wasn't sure that they would fit as my ear canals are smaller but the fit was good and they had a nice selection of ear pieces. When talking on the phone the voice is clear and noise cancellation works good. the touch control works well and volume is easily adjusted. For the price they are a good deal and I would buy they again.
My husband got these for himself and the work great.
